skill.summary: Operates critical high-voltage electricity and gas transmission networks in the UK and US, focusing on regulated returns and clean energy integration.

latestVersion.changelog:
National Grid skill released — overview and deep dive into the UK/US utility’s infrastructure and business.

- Introduces National Grid’s history, business structure, and industry context (English and Chinese).
- Details core operations in electricity transmission, distribution, and US expansion.
- Explains the regulated utility business model, natural monopoly, and role in energy transition.
- Summarizes key milestones and investment plans supporting clean energy goals.
- Presents essential financial, operational, and regulatory facts.
- Highlights the company’s critical role in UK/US energy reliability and future grid planning.
